blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–New import Jordan Murphy was glad to provide what Barangay Ginebra asked of him in Friday’s 129-111 rout of Rain or Shine in the PBA Governors’ Cup before a big crowd at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Murphy turned in 30 points, 13 rebounds, seven assists and four blocks in his debut as the Gin Kings came through with a crucial victory that played a key role in their chase for a quarterfinals berth in Group B. “It feels really good, to be honest,” Murphy said. “It feels like I’ve been here for a lot longer than two weeks to be honest, […]...
